title: plugins: a failed sys_business_unit hierarchy read still answers nobody (and sharing caches it for the pass), so a business-unit graph write can revoke a rule's grants on an outage
body:
domain:server#4 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbacSXJQqAztgt4UMrS

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #29606 dev (os-dev-report 6591481172, `out_of_scope_findings` class a), escalated as should-fix by the contract review of PR #29647 (head `241a137f`). Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2, the same family as #29606 / #29362 / #29503.

## What happens

PR #29647 makes the `sys_business_unit_member` reads complete and loud on failure. The reads of the unit table itself (`sys_business_unit`) still swallow a failure into "nobody", read from source at `origin/main`:

- sharing `BusinessUnitGraphService` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-graph.ts`): `seedIsUsable` (`:133`) catches to `false`, and the empty answer is then cached for the pass (`unitMembers` / `descendants`). `descendants` reads child units at `limit: 1000` (`:105`) and catches to `[]`.
- approvals `expandBusinessUnitUsers` (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`): the seed check catches to `[]`; the descent reads child units at `limit: 1000` (`:3206`) and catches to `[]`.

The #29606 dev measured a fault on a real engine: the not-cached pin first resolved `[]` when the fault hit the seed check rather than the member read.

**Consequence:** the outage #29647 closes for the member table is still reachable through the unit table. A unit-table read failure during a business-unit graph write makes the recompute see "nobody" and revoke every grant a `business_unit` / `unit_and_subordinates` rule gave. In approvals the step gets a shrunk or empty approver list.

## Wanted

- A failed unit read throws (or refuses) instead of answering nobody; absence (`isObjectAbsentError` on the object) still answers `[]`. Nothing is cached after a failed read.
- The child-unit descent reads to completion through the shared `keysetWalk` (`@objectstack/types`), the same as #29647's member reads; no new walk spelling.
- Pins per site: a failed seed read, a failed descent read, 1,001 child units, and absence.

Serial: after PR #29647 (same files). The queue spec posture (`ownership-queue-service.ts`) is #29604's, not this card's.

Dedupe: searched `sys_business_unit descendants`, `seedIsUsable catch`, `expandBusinessUnitUsers seed`; the nearest is #29606 (the member table, PR #29647). **New.**

Links back: #29606, PR #29647, #29362, #29503, #29604.
